The Mountaineers were coached by [[Darian DeVries]] in his first and only season in Morgantown, and played their home games at the [[WVU Coliseum]] located in [[Morgantown, West Virginia]] as members of the [[Big 12 Conference]]. Despite improving upon their 9–23 record from the previous season, the Mountaineers failed to qualify for the NCAA tournament for the second consecutive season. After one season at the helm, DeVries would depart the West Virginia program to become head coach at [[Indiana Hoosiers men's basketball|Indiana]]. ==Previous season== The [[2023–24 West Virginia Mountaineers men's basketball team|Mountaineers]] finished the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2023–24 season]] 9–23, 4–14 in [[2023–24 Big 12 Conference men's basketball season|Big 12 Play]] to finish in a tie for last place. They lost in the first round of the [[2024 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]] to [[2023–24 Cincinnati Bearcats men's basketball team|Cincinnati]].{{cite web |title=2023-24 West Virginia Mountaineers Men's Schedule and Results |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/schools/west-virginia/men/2024-schedule.html |website=Sports Reference |access-date=29 July 2024}}{{cite web |title=2023-24 West Virginia Mountaineers Schedule |url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/teams/WVU/west-virginia-mountaineers/schedule/regular/ |website=CBS Sports |access-date=29 July 2024}} ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" |+ !Name !Pos. !Number !Height !Weight !Previous School !Hometown !Reason for Leaving |- | Noah Farrakhan || 1 || G || 6'2" || 165 || Junior || [[Hillside, New Jersey|Hillside, NJ]] || Transferred to [[Hampton Pirates basketball|Hampton]] |- | Kobe Johnson || 2 || G || 6'3" || 210 || Junior || [[Canton, Ohio|Canton, OH]] || Transferred to [[Saint Louis Billikens men's basketball|Saint Louis]] |- | [[Kerr Kriisa]] || 3 || G || 6'3" || 190 || Senior || [[Tartu|Tartu, Estonia]] || Transferred to [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky]] |- | Jeremiah Bembry || 5 || F || 6'5" || 185 || [[File:Redshirt.svg|15px|Redshirt]] Freshman || [[Brooklyn|Brooklyn, NY]] || Transferred [[Oakland Golden Grizzlies men's basketball|Oakland]]{{Cite web |last=Beers |first=Griffin |date=2024-09-12 |title=Oakland fills out roster with West Virginia’s Bembry |url=https://horizoneroundtable.com/2024/09/12/oakland-fills-out-roster-with-west-virginias-bembry/#:~:text=West%20Virginia%20transfer%20Jeremiah%20Bembry,per%20247%20Sports%20transfer%20rankings. |access-date=2024-12-26 |website=HoriZone Roundtable |language=en-US}} |- | [[Jesse Edwards (basketball)|Jesse Edwards]] || 7 || C || 6'11" || 230 || GS Senior || [[Amsterdam|Amsterdam, Netherlands]] || Graduated/undrafted in [[2024 NBA draft]];
